assets.title: Curly bracket
assets.description: Hand-drawn curly brace that grows to span a group of items (dir h = horizontal, v = vertical), with an optional label. Use to group or total things.

assets.title: Circle highlight
assets.description: Hand-drawn loop that circles a spot, overshooting slightly like a pen. Use to ring a number, button or word; w/h = size of the ring.

assets.title: Confetti burst
assets.description: Burst of paper confetti shot upward from the origin that flutters and falls under closed-form gravity. One-shot: use for celebrations and success moments.

assets.title: Dust puff
assets.description: Cluster of cream dust clouds that billow outward and fade, for landings and impacts. One-shot; place at the contact point.

assets.title: Hand-drawn arrow
assets.description: Wobbly marker arrow that draws itself from tail to head, then breathes. Use to point at something on screen; flip mirrors it, w/h set the span.

assets.title: Highlighter swipe
assets.description: Mustard highlighter pass that wipes across a phrase (multiply blend, slightly tilted). Use behind text for emphasis; w/h match the text box, centred on origin.

assets.title: Motion trail
assets.description: A paper disc that zips along x with fading ghost copies behind it, then settles and bobs. Use to show something moving from A to B; dist = travel in px.

assets.title: Popping !
assets.description: Starburst with a bold exclamation mark that pops in with a wobble and keeps jiggling. Use for surprise, warnings or emphasis near an item.

assets.title: Popping ?
assets.description: Round paper badge with a big question mark that pops in and tilts back and forth. Use for confusion, puzzles or "what is this?".

assets.title: Scribble underline
assets.description: Zig-zag marker underline drawn in two passes under a word. Use to emphasise a phrase; set w to the word width.

assets.title: Sparkle pop
assets.description: Three four-point sparkles that pop in and twinkle forever. Use next to a result, a clean surface or a lucky moment.

assets.title: Speech bubble
assets.description: Rounded speech bubble sized to its text (param text) with a tail to the left or right; pops in and bobs. Use for a line of dialogue, a tip or a label.

assets.title: Speed lines
assets.description: Horizontal streaks that rush past in a seamless loop (closed-form). Use behind a moving object or to add urgency; w/h set the field, dir flips direction.

assets.title: Rubber stamp
assets.description: Boxed rubber-stamp word that slams down large and settles slightly rotated with ink speckles. Use for verdicts: APPROVED, PAID, FAILED, SOLD.

assets.title: Sticker
assets.description: Round die-cut sticker with a cream border, a word and a peeling corner that slaps on with a small spin. Use for NEW, TIP, FREE or a rating badge.

assets.title: Masking tape
assets.description: Translucent mustard tape strip with torn ends that sticks on with a tiny bounce. Use to pin cards, photos or notes; rot sets the angle.

assets.title: Thought bubble
assets.description: Cloud-shaped thought bubble with a trail of three small circles, sized to the text (param text). Use for ideas, doubts or inner questions.

assets.title: Torn paper edge
assets.description: Wide strip of torn cream paper with a ragged top edge and shadow that slides up from below. Use as a section break, a lower-third base or to reveal a new area.

assets.title: Curved arrow
assets.description: Curved paper arrow that sweeps from bottom-left up and over to the right, drawn in with a dash. Use to connect two ideas or point at something.

assets.title: Double arrow
assets.description: Two-way arrow with heads at both ends that breathes in length. Use for exchange, two-way flow, compare or sync.

assets.title: Loop arrows
assets.description: Two arrows chasing each other in a circle that rotate slowly. Use for repeat, refresh, cycle, sync or iteration.

assets.title: Arrow right
assets.description: Chunky paper arrow pointing right that nudges forward. Use for next step, direction, progress or "leads to".

assets.title: Arrow up
assets.description: Chunky arrow pointing up that rises and settles. Use for growth, increase, upload or improvement.

assets.title: Banknote
assets.description: Green paper banknote with a round portrait-free seal and a currency symbol (param symbol). Use for cash, payment, salary or price.

assets.title: Battery
assets.description: Battery whose charge level (param level 0-100) fills in; green when high, red when low. Use for energy, charge, stamina or running out.

assets.title: Bell
assets.description: Notification bell that swings and rings at anchor ring (decaying swing, then still). Use for alerts, reminders or notifications.

assets.title: Bug
assets.description: Red beetle with wiggling legs and antennae. Use for software bugs, errors, defects or pests.

assets.title: Light bulb
assets.description: Light bulb that switches on (param on) with a glow of ink rays. Use for ideas, tips, insight or "aha".

assets.title: Calendar page
assets.description: Wall-calendar page with rings, a red header and a big day number (param day). Use for dates, deadlines, schedules or "on Friday".

assets.title: Shopping cart
assets.description: Wire shopping cart with a basket; wheels turn slowly. Use for e-commerce, buying, checkout or retail.

assets.title: Bar chart icon
assets.description: Small bar-chart icon with rising bars and a trend line (param values). Use for analytics, metrics, reports or growth.

assets.title: Chat bubble
assets.description: Speech bubble with three typing dots or a short text (param text). Use for comments, messages, feedback or conversation.

text.desc: short text (max 6 chars); empty shows typing dots

assets.title: Check badge
assets.description: Scalloped green badge with a check mark that draws in. Use for success, verified, approved or done.

assets.title: Clock
assets.description: Round wall clock whose minute hand sweeps (closed-form, never stops). Use for time, speed, deadlines or waiting.

assets.title: Cloud
assets.description: Flat paper cloud, optionally the cloud-storage symbol. Use for cloud services, uploads, storage or weather-free "the cloud".

assets.title: Coin
assets.description: Mustard coin that spins once as it appears, with a printed symbol (param symbol). Use for money, price, rewards or cost.

assets.title: Coin stack
assets.description: Stack of mustard coins that grows coin by coin (param count). Use for savings, revenue, budget or accumulating money.

assets.title: Cross badge
assets.description: Round red badge with a cross that pops. Use for failure, error, rejected or "no".

assets.title: Database
assets.description: Cylinder database icon with stacked bands. Use for data, storage, records or SQL.

assets.title: Document
assets.description: Paper sheet with a folded corner and text lines. Use for reports, contracts, notes or any file.

assets.title: Envelope
assets.description: Closed envelope with a flap and a red seal dot. Use for email, newsletters, messages or mail.

assets.title: Flag
assets.description: Waving flag on a pole (cloth wave is a closed-form sine). Use for milestones, launch, goals or checkpoints.

assets.title: Folder
assets.description: Manila folder with a tab and a peeking sheet. Use for files, projects, documents or organising.

assets.title: Gear
assets.description: Cog that rotates steadily (closed-form angle). Param teeth sets the tooth count. Use for settings, engineering, process or automation.

assets.title: Heart
assets.description: Pink-red heart that beats gently. Use for love, likes, favourites, health or care.

assets.title: Hourglass
assets.description: Hourglass with sand falling and the glass flipping every 6 s (closed-form). Use for waiting, time left, patience or delay.

assets.title: Key
assets.description: Chunky key with a round bow and two teeth. Use for access, login, solutions or "the key to".

assets.title: Laptop
assets.description: Open laptop with a lit screen. Use for software, work, writing or browsing.

assets.title: Padlock
assets.description: Padlock with keyhole; param locked=false opens the shackle at anchor unlock. Use for security, privacy, paywalls or access.

assets.title: Magnifier
assets.description: Magnifying glass with a pale lens and a glint that sweeps; the whole icon sways. Use for search, inspect, SEO or "look closer".

assets.title: Megaphone
assets.description: Cone megaphone with sound arcs that pulse. Use for announcements, marketing, shouting out or news.

assets.title: Monitor
assets.description: Desktop monitor on a stand showing a chart-like layout. Use for dashboards, desktop software or "on screen".

assets.title: Parcel
assets.description: Cardboard parcel with tape and a label. Use for shipping, delivery, packages or products.

assets.title: Phone
assets.description: Smartphone icon whose screen switches on (param on) with a bar and content lines. Use for mobile apps, notifications or "on your phone".

assets.title: Server rack
assets.description: Three stacked server units with blinking status lights. Use for hosting, backend, infrastructure or "the server".

assets.title: Shield with check
assets.description: Crest-shaped shield with a check mark. Use for protection, trust, safety, guarantees or security.

assets.title: Star
assets.description: Five-point mustard star with a twinkling glint. Use for ratings, favourites, quality or highlights.

assets.title: Tablet
assets.description: Tablet in portrait with a simple app layout. Use for reading, touch interfaces or lightweight apps.

assets.title: Toggle switch
assets.description: Pill toggle switch that flips on (param on) at anchor flip. Use for settings, features, enable/disable or opt-in.

assets.title: Trophy
assets.description: Gold cup with handles and a base plate that glints. Use for winning, awards, first place or achievements.

assets.title: Warning triangle
assets.description: Mustard warning triangle with an exclamation mark that shakes slightly. Use for caution, risk, pitfalls or alerts.

assets.title: Wi-Fi signal
assets.description: Three signal arcs that light up one after another in a loop. Use for connectivity, online, wireless or signal strength.

assets.title: App / browser window with cursor
assets.description: Generic browser window with a moving cursor that clicks, types or scrolls; the content is a list, a bar list or a form given as params. Use to explain a UI, a product flow or "click here, then this happens".
